digest.component_or_area: completion verifier banking and verdict assembly
propositions: At search exhaustion, completion verifier incorrectly banks met=false (refutation) instead of distinguishing insufficient evidence, producing false FAIL verdicts on criteria whose evidence exists but was not reached within budget

The banking write path must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient) via an optional evidence_sufficient:false marker set only by the framework's bounded fallback, not by model tools
Fallback-banked insufficient entries must preserve their marker across subsequent harvests unless explicitly overwritten by genuine refutation; model-facing tools remain bool-only

Schema, validation, finalizer, renderers, and consumers (close gate, audit page, sidecar) must emit distinct messaging for insufficient-evidence FAILs (re-verify, make evidence discoverable) vs refutation FAILs (criteria unmet)
merge_finalizer_with_bank must re-stamp criterion verdicts from the bank (source of truth) over model output to prevent finalizer echoes from losing or gaining the marker
